facts.statement: A community costume event called Graveyard Dance was held in the graveyard in Blackspore on Thursday April 8th, 2010, on Server 1.
facts.quote: Grab your favorite costumes and head to the graveyard in Blackspore for our Graveyard Dance!

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A community event post announcing the Graveyard Dance in Blackspore, a costume party in the graveyard on Thursday April 8th, 2010, held at two times for US/Latin America and UK/Europe on Server 1. It also explains how to find community events through the Game Guide calendar and the GO button.
